floor_estimate.draw_statistic: official score_aia score: max(all, rare after SE deadzone)
floor_estimate.limitation: Mock floors only; Monte Carlo SE excludes population and generator mismatch.

mia.known_private_basis: Exact unique self-challenge QI matches plus contest private-block design

v4.selection_basis: Route only releases whose public QI/outcome association is below the shadow-separated AUC threshold. The validated v3 membership selection is held exactly fixed and only active times are replaced.

v3.selection_basis: Leaderboard aggregates do not separate target-wise selection and time-link errors, so the validated v2 AIA is retained.

independent.algorithm: public outcome-integrity router over reusable multiview residual and horizon codebook experts

aia.complement: v7 complement of three active sets, edge time 9.5; two fixed routed experts

case_metadata.control_generation: Identical exact-key conditional donor kernel; no post-generation covariate replacement
case_metadata.rare_label_source: Synthetic birth labels inherited from supplied B_self is_rare strata; not detector predictions
limitations: Synthetic joint topology, birth labels and matching quotas reproduce public structure, not hidden official records.
Finite empirical donor profiles are reused with smoothing; synthetic identities are not independent people.
Dev and holdout use disjoint donor rows but are synthetic draws from the same supplied sources.
Release family frequencies are stress scenarios, not estimates of actual competitors' methods.
Private prefecture concentration is not modeled; this topology is one plausible structural scenario.
